remotePath: Owner asked on 2026-10-07 to audit the GPT 7.1.97 Forms workflow candidate and to fix the blocking findings before deployment. Deploy only main after candidate gates pass.

ownerDecision.source: Explicit owner instruction on 2026-10-07: audit 7.1.97 (Forms workflow F1-F9), fix blocking findings (CI chain, late/repeated START marker, manual override) and prepare it for publication through the protected release chain.

E6_INCIDENT.note: Owner deferred E6. Historical raw/cache purge and private credential rotation are not certified complete.

LIVE_FORMS.note: Owner checked the school Form settings for the 2026-10-06 lesson (owner confirmation, not an independent inspection). The 7.1.97 prefill, KOD field and START/END markers are verified only with synthetic Google-export CSV; the first real lesson must confirm them on the live form.

E7_PHYSICAL.note: Physical mobile behavior will be tested during the supervised Tuesday and Friday student experiment.

independentReview.note: The same reviewer audited the GPT candidate and authored the follow-up fixes; no separate review of those fixes.

limitations: Publication is authorized for the supervised student red-team experiment; physical mobile compatibility is not certified.
E6 remains deferred and open; a clean current branch does not prove historical cache removal.
Client-controlled telemetry and consistent public-key forgery require teacher review; the static runtime is not trusted server authentication.
Physical phones and live Forms for this new export were not independently exercised. Further independent review of 7.1.97 was explicitly waived by owner; this is not an independent PASS.
Exact candidate and protected-main CI must complete before the existing promotion workflow may deploy.
START marker tolerance is 10 minutes; a manually entered lesson time overrides CSV markers and is labelled as manual in results.
